title: Deeper Dive data compatibility
failFast: Any checklist item clearly violated on touched Cassandra/Kafka/cache/analytics paths → score < 90
Backward-incompatible Proto field reuse or breaking Cassandra change without dual-write/compat story → score < 90

rubric.90: Data/compat risk acceptable for human CR
rubric.70: Mostly compatible; mustFix for secondary checklist gaps
rubric.40: Blocking schema, cache TTL, or dual-write issues

prompt.task: Score Cassandra, Kafka Proto, cache, and analytics compatibility of this change
instructions: Read skillRefs deeperdive-data and the checklistPaths before scoring
Check Cassandra schema changes for backward compatibility and dual-write completeness
Check Kafka Protobuf: no field number reuse; readers remain compatible
Check cache TTL / invalidation against known layers (Caffeine, Memcached, Cassandra)
Check publisher_id type consistency and analytics aggregation impact
If the diff does not touch data paths, score high and note N/A findings — do not invent issues
Apply failFast and rubric from this scorer declaration
Score 0-100; 90+ means data/compat risk is acceptable for human CR
List mustFix for any compatibility blockers

title: Deeper Dive pipeline fit
failFast: Change bypasses ValidationPipeline / generation stages with a side-door path → score < 90
ROP/Either flow broken in qna pipeline code (unchecked control flow where Vavr is the idiom) → score < 90
Omni indexing touched without coexistence / write-gate conventions → score < 90

rubric.90: Architecture/pipeline fit ready for human CR
rubric.70: Mostly fits; localized mustFix for stage placement or conventions
rubric.40: Wrong service boundary or pipeline bypass

prompt.task: Score whether the change fits search-engine-qna pipelines, validation stages, and ROP patterns
instructions: Read skillRefs deeperdive-search-engine and deeperdive-architecture plus checklistPaths
Prefer changes that extend ValidationPipeline / generation / regeneration stages cleanly
Flag side-door logic that bypasses validation or breaks Either/ROP flow
Check cache-miss → Kafka → generate → serve coherence for serving-related changes
If goal/diff mentions omni indexing, also apply search-engine-omni-crawl-consumer review conventions when that skill pointer is present
Apply failFast and rubric from this scorer declaration
Score 0-100; 90+ means architecture fit is ready for human CR
List mustFix for pipeline/architecture blockers

title: Taboola Java / Spring quality
failFast: Any CRITICAL java-quality rule violated in the touched Java → score capped below 90
New code ignores file-local idiom (imperative vs Vavr Option/Try) → score < 90

rubric.90: Java/Spring quality ready for human CR (no CRITICAL violations)
rubric.70: No CRITICAL issues; MEDIUM debt remains in mustFix
rubric.40: Multiple CRITICAL or severe Spring/exception issues

prompt.role: senior Java/Spring reviewer for Taboola backend
prompt.task: Score the change against Taboola java-quality rules (SOLID, Spring Boot, exceptions, concurrency, naming)
instructions: Load skillRefs java-quality and read checklistPaths (checklist + critical/spring-boot/exception rules)
Treat CRITICAL rule violations as mustFix; failFast caps score below 90
Respect file-local idiom (e.g. Vavr Option/Try chains) over generic imperative style
Flag Spring wiring, DI, and profile anti-patterns when relevant
If no Java files changed, score high with N/A findings
Apply failFast and rubric from this scorer declaration
Score 0-100; 90+ means Java/Spring quality is ready for human CR
List mustFix for critical and blocking medium issues
